objective: Write the leaf pure modules of Lantern Express with their specs: LanternConfig (every GDD value, tiles, tracks, cars), LootRules (stops and critter rolls), CarryRules (carrying, loading, the fog) and WispRules (nights and the Lampeater).
acceptance_criteria: Signatures exactly as architecture 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5; every value equals GDD section C, F, H and decision 0018 section 5

LanternConfig.TILES has 8 tiles with 24 small and 8 big sites and building boxes; LanternConfig.TRACKS has the two 5,700-stud loops (stops at 700, 1,400, 2,100; radius >= 600 at night) and the two Dawn tracks; CARS total 78 studs with 12 seats (LanternConfig.spec)

LootRules: counts per GDD C6, deterministic builds, stop 1 crate on the 22-stud site, odds sums of 10,000 for every line, leg, tile and band, 100,000-roll frequencies within 0.5 points, Moon Hare only on leg 3 far crates (LootRules.spec)
CarryRules: one spec case per cell of the GDD J table, speeds 16 / 15 / 13 / 9 / 13, full bunker keeps coal carried, close loses every free and carried item (CarryRules.spec)

WispRules: wave sizes per GDD C6, the 7-degree cone edges, clampAim refusals, exposure across beams, puff times 0.6 / 0.45 / 0.35, aims sent faster never puff faster, Lampeater timing, shoo and fed (WispRules.spec)
lune run tests/run, selene, stylua --check, validate-tasks and check-scope pass; Purity.spec covers the four modules
verification: CI; A15 reviews the specs against the GDD tables
evidence: Local run 2026-11-06 on game6/concept (after 8289f47): lune run tests/run 651/651 pass (was 578; +73: LanternConfig.spec 14, LootRules.spec 11, CarryRules.spec 36, WispRules.spec 12); selene src tests 0 errors 0 warnings; stylua --check clean on the changed files and an LF copy of tests/run.luau; Purity.spec scans all of src/shared, so it covers the four modules without a change; node tools/validate-tasks.mjs and node tools/check-scope.mjs origin/main pass

Pins: every C1 to C5, F and H3 value, the five odds rows (each 10,000), C6 counts and wave sizes, 100,000-roll rarity frequencies within 0.5 points for all five rows and species frequencies against LootRules.odds on one tile; the 22-stud crate on stop 1 for 600 seeded builds; one CarryRules case for each of the 30 J-table cells (5 kinds x carried, dropped, caught, leaves, left at the stop, loaded: a caught or left critter crate ends lost and is never returned by load); puffs at exactly 0.6 / 0.45 / 0.35 s and no sooner at 40 Hz ticks; waves 8, 33, 58 ... 158 (7 by 180 s); leg 3 waves 8 and 33, warning 47, dives 58 + 8k, unlit dive -10, 0.8 s shoo, fed once at 15 + 8 (n - 1)

Deviations: GDD C4's parenthetical dim formula 12 / (min(n, 4) + 1) gives 6 / 4 / 3 / 2.5 and contradicts its own table; the table value 6 / 4.5 / 3.5 / 3 (C6, decision 0018, pacing script) is used and pinned. The loops measure about 1,570 x 1,620 studs, not the 1,100 x 650 of architecture 3.1, which cannot hold a radius-600 night curve. Added data the architecture leaves implicit: LINE_TILES, RARITY_COLOURS (C7), BIG_DEPTHS, APPROACH 200, TRAIN_LENGTH 78, SEAT_COUNTS and OUTER (the stop side of each loop as a multiple of TrackRules.right). Track lengths and radii are checked in LANTERN-004 with TrackRules (measured: loops 5,700.0, Dawn tracks 5,700.0, day radius >= 197, night >= 632)
notes: LanternConfig.TILES is the contract LANTERN-009 models the tiles around: land it before the tile art starts. The track control points are authored here (architecture 3.1); TrackRules (LANTERN-004) measures them, so LanternConfig.spec's length and radius checks join LANTERN-004's run if TrackRules is not merged yet (a stub test is fine).
